article.title: ‘We’re living in darkness’: six years of scaffolding, still no post-Grenfell cladding

article.content: Building safety regulator delays leave London tower block beset by security and vandalism problems It’s a sunny day with bright blue skies in north London, but you wouldn’t know that in Natasha Dyett’s flat. Most of the rooms are consumed in shadow, while her teenage son’s bedroom is almost completely dark, apart from a few slits of light coming through the window. She lives in Archway Heights, a nine-storey block of flats that has been covered in scaffolding for more than six years for cladding works that still haven’t started. Continue reading...
